svg.title: E-02 2 m Hairpin Detail - Tape Measure Satellite Yagi
svg.desc: Rev A 2 m hairpin starting shape and O7/O8 record controls derived from O3-O6 Rev L.
svg.text: FOR REVIEW - SOURCE O3-O6 REV L
VIEW A | CUT THE INITIAL BLANK
2M-HP | FULLY BARE #12 AWG SOLID COPPER; STRIP WITHOUT NICKING.
8.500 IN INITIAL BLANK; MEASURE BEFORE FORMING
O7 CUT / LABEL / RECORD. THIS IS STOCK LENGTH, NOT THE FINISHED LEG LENGTH OR AN RF MATCH SETTING.
VIEW B | SYMMETRIC U STARTING SHAPE
TOP VIEW IN THE 2 m ELEMENT PLANE; SHAPE FROM THE ACTUAL FEED HARDWARE.
ONE SMOOTH 180 DEG BEND; NO KINK
MEASURE BEND DIA AS FORMED; DO NOT DERIVE THE FINISHED SHAPE FROM 8.500.
U EXTENDS AWAY FROM THE 70 cm BOOM AND REAR COAX ROUTE.
70 cm BOOM / REAR COAX KEEP-OUT REFERENCE
POSITION IS SCHEMATIC; VERIFY ON THE BUILT ANTENNA
WHERE ACTUAL ASSEMBLY PERMITS; RECORD ACTUAL GAP.
FEED NODE C-C N / LEG SPACING S
DO NOT TRIM BEFORE INITIAL CALIBRATED O8 MEASUREMENT.
IF TRIMMED: RECORD EQUAL TRIM AT BOTH ENDS AND FINAL SHAPE.
ONE HAIRPIN END FREE: 2 m BNC PIN-TO-SHELL OPEN.
BOTH ENDS SECURED: CONTINUITY THROUGH HAIRPIN.
RECHECK GAP / ROUTING / DC AFTER EACH CHANGE.
1. DIMENSIONS IN INCHES. VIEW A CUT LENGTH IS 1:1 AT 100% PRINT; VIEWS B / C ARE NTS.
2. EACH END HOOK IS HELD AT ITS OWN M-07 FEED NODE; USE APPROVED #6-32 STACK.
3. MATCH REQUIRES O8 IMPEDANCE / SWR DATA; 8.500 IN ALONE DOES NOT SET REACTANCE.
